generator_metadata.summary: Square grid with three source colors; copy every nonzero cell to its transposed coordinate while preserving every original source cell.

review_brief:
# Review

Repaired the base main-diagonal-reflection generator, built the native `reflection_scope` family, and attacked the minimum lesson rather than only testing declared settings. The first source defect was transpose-pair collisions that allowed the canonical overlay to overwrite originals; the second, found by strict defect lint, was permissive `seed`/`sample_index` typing. Both have focused regressions.

The adversarial probe covered fixed color, fixed diagonal slot, frequency/position cues, matched-input controls, malformed counts/grids/settings, duplicate inputs, forged labels, prefix stability, and substantive 30×30 scenes. No known shortcut survives the two-demo minimum on the exercised support. Protected Racket labels, source-bound preflight, causal counterfactual replay, and one-query public projection all pass.

Finite testing is not a proof over all grids. The family is ready for owner review, not owner-accepted or training-admitted.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent cue color selected from that diagonal cell.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Locate the unique nonzero cell on the main diagonal and read its color.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Mask the source grid to cells with the cue color, transpose that mask, and overlay it on the original grid.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The cells mirrored by step B are selected by the cue color produced by step A; changing that intermediate changes the final protected-Racket output.

parametric_work.summary: Native adapter supports reflection_scope=all|diagonal_cued, 2–6 demos, 1–4 queries, matched inputs, four distinct queries including 30x30, protected-Racket qualification, and a replayed A→cue-color→selective-reflection witness.

target_report.summary: Repaired collision-prone canonical generation and strict call controls; built a source-bound reflection_scope family with an exact canonical default, an input-derived diagonal-cue variant, a causal protected-Racket witness, four-query sequential projection, and bounded shortcut attacks.
